title: Back to the Future
synopsis: Hill Valley, 1985. The DeLorean. The lightning. You end up in 1955, where your mother has a crush on you. Don't break the timeline.

nodes.text: 1:21 gigawatts. Libyans. The clock starts.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Speed.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Smart.

nodes.text: You arrive. Cows. A farmer with a shotgun.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Civil.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Smart—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Soda fountain. Your dad, George, getting bullied.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Right—follows you into whatever comes next.
“Don't intervene” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Wise.

nodes.text: You order something. Lou is mean. You meet a boy who would become your dad's enemy.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Civil.
You commit to “Leave.” The story records the instinct as “Smart” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Lorraine sees you. She is, against all expectation, smitten.

choices.consequence: “Be polite” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Wise.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Wise—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: You find young Doc in his garage. You show him the flux capacitor.

choices.consequence: “Tell him the future” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Brave.
You commit to “Tell him only the basics.” The story records the instinct as “Smart” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Hill Valley High. George reads sci-fi in a closet.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Path—follows you into whatever comes next.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Smart—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: You convince George to ask Lorraine. He freezes. You volunteer to set it up.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Path.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Smart.

nodes.text: She asks you to the dance. You realize the plan requires improvisation.

choices.text: Pretend to fall in love with her
choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Strategy—follows you into whatever comes next.
“Be direct” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honest.

nodes.text: Biff and his goons threaten George. You bait the car.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Plan.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Smart.

nodes.text: Lorraine kisses you. She says it feels like kissing her brother.

choices.consequence: “Note the timeline glitch” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Wise.
“Be relieved” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honest.

nodes.text: Biff opens the door. Things move fast.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Smart.
There is no taking “Fight” back. Brave shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: George, against his shape, throws a punch.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Step back.” The story records the instinct as “Honor” and carries it forward.
“Cheer” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Joy.

nodes.text: Earth Angel. They kiss. You start to fade from the photo.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Pick up the guitar” back. Path shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
“Stand still” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honest.

nodes.text: You play. The band is ahead. The audience is, briefly, not ready.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Tone it down.” The story records the instinct as “Wise” and carries it forward.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Joy.

nodes.text: Lightning, wire, clocktower. The plan is precise.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Drive.” The story records the instinct as “Path” and carries it forward.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Wise.

nodes.text: You write Doc a letter about Libyans. You leave it in his coat.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Right.
You commit to “Tell him in person.” The story records the instinct as “Honest” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: It hits the wire. The car accelerates.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Steady.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Speed—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Twin Pines becomes Lone Pine. The Libyans aren't here yet, then they are.

choices.consequence: “Save Doc” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honor.
“Run to safety” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Smart.

nodes.text: Your dad is a successful novelist. Lorraine is happy. Biff polishes the car.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Notice everything.” The story records the instinct as “Wise” and carries it forward.
You commit to “Just enjoy.” The story records the instinct as “Honest” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Doc arrives in the DeLorean. The kids, he says.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Get in.” The story records the instinct as “Path” and carries it forward.
There is no taking “Wait” back. Honest shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
Some endings reveal themselves last.

nodes.text: You go to 2015. You return. You marry Jennifer. You become, eventually, a parent yourself, slightly more patient than your own dad.
You let Doc go alone. You build a normal life in 1985 with the parents you accidentally made better. You play guitar in a small band on weekends.
You and Doc become lifelong collaborators. You don't, in the end, mass-produce anything. You build, mostly, one-off wonders. People drive across the country to see your garage.
